about_blocks.text: The Detox Program welcomes you into the first step of the recovery process. We recognize that the decision to change your lifestyle is difficult. The detox staff believe that you have the strength to make a better life for yourself. Any adult resident of Kamloops and area who is recovering from a substance misuse problem. You must not be at risk of withdrawal related complications. Your physical health must be stable, and free from conditions that will be worsened bywithdrawal. You live in a stable home environment and have a support network ready to assist you. Participation is based on 4 weeks of programming, however, this program is designed to be a flexible program; there is no minimum or maximum number of hours that you must attend.

sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
